# mm against its capture; speed: a loop's travel as captured, % of standing hip height a second.

column6: desc
An everyday walk at a steady pace, arms swinging loosely. One stride cycle, in place
Swordplay: from a guard, a lunge forward with the sword arm thrust straight out, then a recovery back
A zombie's shamble: head and shoulders slumped forward, a dragging step, arms hanging. One cycle, in place
A gorilla: hunched, knuckles low, a rolling heavy walk. One cycle, in place
A robot, acted by a person: stiff, jerky steps and arm moves in straight lines
Jumping jacks: hop the feet apart while the arms swing up overhead, then back together. One jack, in place
A boxer's guard: fists up by the face, bouncing light on the feet, weaving a little. In place
From the guard, a straight jab with the lead fist, snapped back to the guard
Climbing a ladder hand over hand, rising about a step a second (no ladder is drawn)
Sweeping the floor with a broom, steady strokes (no broom is drawn). In place
Washing a window: one hand wiping in circles at head height (no window is drawn). In place
A spinning jump kick (a tornado kick): a run-up, a leap that turns the body round with a high roundhouse kick in the air, landing turned away
Toppling forward flat onto the face
A cartwheel to the side: hands to the floor one after the other, legs wheeling over, back up to standing
A steady run, arms pumping. One stride cycle, in place
Sneaking: crouched low, stepping carefully, arms held in close. One cycle, in place
Limping on a wounded leg: a short careful step on the bad leg, a longer one on the good. One cycle, in place
Standing a little hunched, looking warily about
Crouching to search the ground, peering about and poking at it
Walking hunched over, a hand clutching the stomach. One cycle, in place
Walking backwards at an easy pace. One cycle, in place
Walking crouched low on deeply bent knees. One cycle, in place
Hopping on the left foot, the right held up, arms out for balance. One hop, in place
A run that skids to a sudden stop, leaning back to brake
Running, a leap over an obstacle, and running on
Running, ducking low under something, and running on
Running, a dive forward over something into a shoulder roll, back up and running
A jump straight up with a full spin in the air, landing facing forward again
Breakdance: on the floor, the legs sweeping round under the body (the helicopter)
A fighter's punch combination from a guard: jabs, crosses and hooks
Blocks from a fighting stance: forearm blocks high, middle and low
A karate front kick (mae-geri): knee up, foot snapped straight ahead, back to the stance
A karate roundhouse kick (mawashi-geri): the leg swings round in an arc at head height
A karate side kick (yoko-geri): the body turned side on, the heel driven out sideways
Karate stepping punches (oi-zuki): a long stride forward with a straight punch on each step
Getting up from lying face down: push up on the arms, a knee under, stand
Getting up from lying on the back: sit up, roll to a knee, stand
Getting up from lying on the side
Ducking from something thrown: dropping into a tight crouch with the head covered, staying down, then rising
Chopping wood: an axe raised overhead in both hands and brought down hard, again and again (no axe is drawn)
Digging with a spade: foot on the blade, lever back, toss the earth aside (no spade is drawn)
Fishing: a cast with a rod, waiting, then reeling in (no rod is drawn)
Drinking a glass of water
Moving a heavy box: squat, lift with effort, carry a few steps, set it down (no box is drawn)
Raking leaves with long pulls toward the feet (no rake is drawn)
Shaking hands with someone in front
Walking up to a box, bending to lift it, and carrying it off (no box is drawn)
Sitting down on a chair and getting up again (no chair is drawn)
Waving hello with a raised hand
A shrug: shoulders up, palms turned out, who knows
A big stretch with a yawn, arms reaching up overhead
A curtsey: one foot behind, knees dipping, a small bow of the head
Waiting impatiently: shifting weight from foot to foot, looking about
Frankenstein's monster: stiff legs, arms held straight out ahead, a heavy lurching walk. One cycle, in place
A monkey, acted by a person: hunched, scratching, hopping about
A bear, acted by a person: heavy, lumbering, rearing up with paws raised
A dragon, acted by a person: arms as wings, a prowl and a roar
A ghost, acted by a person: gliding, arms floating up, a spooky drift
A chicken, acted by a person: elbows as flapping wings, pecking, strutting
A standing backflip: a deep swing of the arms, a jump up and over backwards, landing on the feet
